prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":1,"r":1},"outputs":{"q":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"q","meaning":"Single-bit stored state presented as output q; it is forced to 0 by synchronous active-high reset and otherwise captures d at the sampled posedge.","update_time":"posedge clk after the sampled edge has settled","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"sync_active_high_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"At the sampled posedge clk, r == 1; q is updated to 0 regardless of d.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"r":1},{"d":0,"r":1},{"d":1,"r":1}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":0},{"q":0}]}},{"id":"d_capture_when_not_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"At the sampled posedge clk, r == 0; q is updated to the sampled value of d.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"Implement a simple D flip flop","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":0,"r":0},{"d":1,"r":0},{"d":0,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":1},{"q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"r","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first sampled posedge clk with r == 0; on that edge q follows d"},"mid":"Mid changes to d or r occur after the sampled posedge and before the other edge, are carried to the start of the next row, and affect q only at the next sampled posedge.","uncertain":[]}
response: {"coverage":{"S01":["sync_active_high_reset","d_capture_when_not_reset"]},"issues":[{"issue_id":"I1","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"high","detail":"Spec does not define clock edge polarity; contract assumes posedge clk and marks rules non-uncertain.","spec_evidence":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0).","alternative":"Negative-edge-triggered D flip-flop with synchronous active-high reset on negedge clk.","sequence":[{"d":0,"r":1},{"d":1,"r":0,"mid":{"d":1,"r":1}},{"d":1,"r":1,"mid":{"d":1,"r":0}},{"d":0,"r":0}]}]}
